newsitem.title: JAPAN: INSIGHT - JGBs seen weaker for second day.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - JGBs seen weaker for second day.

text.p: Key June 10-year Japanese government bond (JGB) futures are likely to ease for a second day in a row on Thursday, traders said.

They said that even with short-covering by dealers to roll-over short positions to the September contract ahead of a benchmark shift, the June may see a resistance point at 124.00-124.10, then at 124.40.

Disappointment at Wednesday's limited rises had weakened sentiment, a brokerage house dealer said. "The market had expected the June to rise smoothly toward 124.50 on Wednesday, but it failed to do so. This worsened a chart outlook."
